_purpose: Words the speech-to-text model writes for KPCL station / reservoir names, and what they mean. Loaded by app/voice_guard.py and applied by app/spoken.py clean_transcript. Every entry is validated at load and by tests/test_voice_guards.py: 'heard' must not be (or sound exactly like) a real station, reservoir or supplier name, or an ordinary question word; 'means' must be a name the data knows. Invalid entries are ignored.
_how_to_add: Only from real officer recordings collected with their consent (set VOICE_COLLECT_MISHEARINGS=true; text only, no audio, written to logs/voice_mishearings.jsonl). Review with: python tests/review_mishearings.py; add with: python tests/review_mishearings.py --add <heard>=<Name> --reviewer <name>. Then run the tests.
